# 1.

Pick a year. Create a dataset which only contains that data for that year and is appropriately labeled. For example, if you choose the year `2007`, you might choose to call this new dataset `gapminder2007`. You will use this dataset for the rest of the assignment.

```{r}
gapminder2007 <- gapminder |>
  filter(year==2007)

head(gapminder2007)
```

# 2.

Using your dataset you created in 1, create a barplot which displays the GDP per capita of the ten countries with the highest GDP per capita that year. Be sure your axes are appropriately labeled. *I would suggest piping in a wrangled dataset here. There are other ways too.*

```{r}
gapminder2007 |>
  arrange(desc(gdpPercap)) |>
  slice(1:10) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(y=country, x=gdpPercap))
```
